chunks: Let each one of you adorn himself on the day of Jumu‘ah, perform ghusl, apply perfume, comb his hair, and wear his cleanest clothes. Let him prepare himself for Jumu‘ah, and let tranquility and dignity be upon him on that day. Let him excel in the worship of his Lord and do as much good as he can, for indeed Allah, majestic is His remembrance, looks upon the earth to multiply the good deeds.

key_terms.أَنْظَفَ ثِيَابِهِ: his cleanest clothes, indicating personal cleanliness and respect for the occasion
key_terms.الْحَسَنَاتِ: good deeds, which are multiplied by Allah
key_terms.عِبَادَةَ رَبِّهِ: the worship of his Lord, referring to devoted acts of worship
key_terms.وَيَتَطَيَّبُ: to apply perfume and present oneself pleasantly
key_terms.وَيَغْتَسِلُ: to perform ghusl, the ritual bath
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the day of Friday, a specially honored day for worship and preparation

ai.seo_question: How should a believer prepare for Jumu‘ah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages believers to prepare themselves outwardly and inwardly for Jumu‘ah through cleanliness, beautification, dignity, and worship. It presents Friday as a special occasion for intensified devotion and righteous action, when Allah multiplies good deeds.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.244 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

'Let each of you adorn himself on Jumu’ah; perform the ritual bath (ghusl), apply perfume, comb your hair, and wear your cleanest clothes. He should prepare for Jumu’ah and embody tranquility and dignity on that day.
He should enhance worship your Lord (azj) excellently and do as much good as you can, for surely Allah (swt), the Exalted, looks upon the earth to multiply the good deeds (on Jumu’ah)."
